attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across node1 (writable primary), node2 and node3 (read-only standbys), using pg_basebackup with a dedicated replicator role. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol (standbys first, primary last) with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart recovery/data verification at each step.
